title: LLM Integration
lead: Local-first LLM assistance — Ollama and friends by default, BYOK external never silently.
summary: MemPalace layers optional, pluggable LLM assistance over five domains: entity refinement, closet regeneration, corpus-origin detection, room detection, and fact-checking. Every LLM step is opt-in and local-first — Ollama, LM Studio, and llama.cpp on localhost are the default, with OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic providers available only via explicit BYOK. External endpoints always trigger a privacy warning before first use, and when an LLM is unavailable or fails the system falls back to its heuristic/regex baseline and records what happened. No operation ever blocks on an LLM, and no data is silently discarded.

concepts.definition: LLM assistance defaults to user-hosted Ollama/LM Studio/llama.cpp on localhost (offline, no API required). External providers are supported only via explicit BYOK; never enabled silently.

Three provider classes (OllamaProvider, OpenAICompatProvider, AnthropicProvider) share a common interface (classify, check_available, is_external_service) to normalize JSON-mode requests across vendor differences.
When LLM is unavailable or fails, the system always falls back to its heuristic/regex baseline and records what happened. No data is discarded silently; the user is informed.

Endpoint locality is checked by URL parsing (localhost, RFC1918, Tailscale CGNAT, mDNS, IPv6 ULA ranges). External endpoints trigger a warning; local inference does not. file:// and non-HTTP schemes are rejected to prevent exfiltration.

LLM responses are parsed with multi-strategy fallback: first try raw JSON, then extract from markdown backticks, then scan for braced/bracketed payloads. Only if all strategies fail is the batch skipped with an error recorded.

Optional reclassification of regex-detected entities (candidates from prose) into person/project/topic/common-word/ambiguous via LLM, with batch processing to bound token usage and contextual sampling to improve signal.

Optional regeneration of keyword/topic indices (closets) from drawer content via LLM, overlaying richer topic extraction on top of regex baselines. Fallback: regex closets remain untouched if LLM fails.

Two-tier detection of whether content is AI-dialogue. Tier 1: fast regex heuristic. Tier 2: optional LLM confirmation + persona extraction. Tier 2 merges results, never overwrites heuristic confidence.
Offline verification of text against entity registry (edit distance ≤ 2) and knowledge graph (relationship mismatch, stale facts). Purely local; no API; zero cost.

symbols.name: LLMProvider
symbols.role: Base class for all LLM providers. Defines interface: classify(system, user, json_mode, think), check_available(), is_external_service property. Subclasses override classify() with provider-specific HTTP calls; check_available() to probe reachability; optionally override is_external_service if endpoint resolution is dynamic.

symbols.name: OllamaProvider
symbols.role: Concrete provider for Ollama (localhost:11434 default). Supports num_ctx tuning. Implements JSON mode as format: json. This is the local-first default.

symbols.name: OpenAICompatProvider
symbols.role: Concrete provider for any OpenAI /v1/chat/completions endpoint (LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM, Groq, Together, etc.). Supports OPENAI_API_KEY env var. Implements JSON mode as response_format: {type: json_object}.

symbols.name: AnthropicProvider
symbols.role: Concrete provider for Anthropic Messages API. Requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Implements JSON mode by appending 'Respond with valid JSON only' to system prompt. Never probes (to avoid spending money); first real call surface auth errors.

symbols.name: get_provider
symbols.role: Factory function. Takes provider name (ollama/openai-compat/anthropic), model, endpoint, api_key, and provider-specific kwargs. Returns instantiated provider or raises LLMError on unknown provider. Used by CLI and corpus_origin.

symbols.name: _endpoint_is_local
symbols.role: Single source of truth for endpoint locality. Returns True for localhost, RFC1918, Tailscale CGNAT, mDNS, IPv6 ULA. Used by is_external_service property to decide privacy warning. Empty/unparseable URLs default to local.

symbols.name: refine_entities
symbols.role: Optional LLM refinement of regex-detected entities. Batches candidates, samples context, sends to LLM, parses responses with _extract_json_candidates(), applies decisions, returns RefineResult. Ctrl-C safe. Batch failures are recorded but don't abort.

symbols.name: regenerate_closets
symbols.role: Optional regeneration of closets (topic indices) via configured OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint. Batches drawers by source, sends content, parses JSON with retry-on-error, upserts new closets with metadata. Regex closets remain fallback.

symbols.name: check_text
symbols.role: Offline fact-checking. Validates text against entity registry (edit-distance ≤ 2) and KG (relationship_mismatch, stale_fact). Purely local; no API. Returns list of issues or empty list (no contradictions found). Used by diary-save hooks + MCP tools.

symbols.name: detect_rooms_local
symbols.role: Main entry point for zero-API room detection. Walks folder structure, checks against FOLDER_ROOM_MAP, falls back to filename patterns, presents to user for approval, saves to mempalace.yaml. No API required.

surprises.title: Ollama's num_ctx parameter is forwarded via **kwargs for context-window tuning
surprises.detail: OllamaProvider accepts num_ctx (optional int) as a constructor kwarg, allowing callers to tune context window per model without modifying the provider interface. The factory forwards unknown kwargs (**provider_kwargs) to the chosen provider, so get_provider(..., num_ctx=8192) works seamlessly. This is elegant extensibility: each provider ignores kwargs it doesn't recognize.

surprises.title: corpus_origin Tier-2 result merging is a careful non-overwrite dance, not a simple merge
surprises.detail: After discovering that Tier-2 LLM (weak local model) can flip Tier-1 heuristic confidence (issue #1211), the code was updated to preserve Tier-1's likely_ai_dialogue + confidence while merging Tier-2's platform/user/personas into the result. The evidence trails are concatenated (not deduplicated) to preserve both signal paths for auditability. This is a non-obvious invariant enforced in the CLI, not in corpus_origin.py itself.

surprises.title: Closet regeneration pagination avoids SQLite SQLITE_MAX_VARIABLE_NUMBER crashes
surprises.detail: Large palaces (10k+ drawers) would crash on a single get(limit=total) call because SQLite's SQLITE_MAX_VARIABLE_NUMBER (32766) limit is hit inside ChromaDB. The code pages in batches of 5000, processing each batch and continuing. Without this, regenerate_closets fails silently on large palaces (issue #802, #850, #1073).

surprises.title: Non-HTTP/HTTPS endpoint schemes are explicitly rejected to prevent exfiltration
surprises.detail: closet_llm validates that LLM_ENDPOINT uses http:// or https:// only. A misconfigured file:// endpoint (or similar) cannot be used to read local files and exfiltrate them. The check is defensive (the code never builds such a URL intentionally, but the validation is explicit).

surprises.title: Fact-checker extracts claims conservatively with two regex patterns, not full NLP
surprises.detail: Only two surface forms are recognized: 'X is Y's Z' and 'X's Z is Y' (both resolve to triple (X, Z, Y) — subject, predicate, object). No NLP; just regex. This is intentional: the detector is ultra-conservative, only flagging contradictions it's certain about. Unrecognized relationship forms are silently missed (false-negatives), not misinterpreted (false-positives).

designDecisions.decision: Three-provider model instead of a single generic OpenAI-compat wrapper
designDecisions.rationale: Ollama deserves first-class treatment (local-first principle, issue CLAUDE.md line 25). OpenAI-compat covers LM Studio/llama.cpp/vLLM but not Anthropic's Messages API. Anthropic gets its own provider for auth + cost-conserving design (no probes, extended thinking toggles). Shared interface (LLMProvider base) avoids code duplication. Each provider is lean — Anthropic is ~40 lines, Ollama ~70 lines.

designDecisions.decision: Endpoint locality heuristic as single source of truth, not per-provider logic
designDecisions.rationale: Privacy is cross-cutting (issue #24). Ollama at localhost should never warn; Anthropic at https://api.anthropic.com should always warn. Putting the heuristic in llm_client._endpoint_is_local() ensures all callers (cli.py, closet_llm.py, mcp_server.py) see identical locality semantics. No provider subclass can override or weaken the check.

designDecisions.decision: Opt-in LLM refinement with batch processing + interruption safety
designDecisions.rationale: Entity refinement is optional (default init never imports llm_refine). Batching keeps token cost bounded (~50-100K for huge corpora). Ctrl-C mid-run returns a RefineResult with cancelled=True and partial results — respects user agency and produces a usable output instead of rolling back. Interactive UX (progress bar, elapsed time) keeps the user informed.

designDecisions.decision: Tier-1 heuristic + Tier-2 LLM merge rather than replacement in corpus-origin
designDecisions.rationale: Weak local models can misclassify AI-dialogue. Per PR #1211 review, preserve heuristic's likely_ai_dialogue + confidence (which proved accurate) and only merge LLM's persona extraction (where weak models are still useful). Both evidence trails are preserved for auditability. This prevents a weak LLM from degrading detection quality.

designDecisions.decision: Fact-checking as offline module, not an LLM service
designDecisions.rationale: Contradictions require precise matching (edit distance ≤ 2 for names, exact match for relationships). An LLM can hallucinate or soften thresholds. Using entity registry + KG (both local, fast) is deterministic and auditable. The system is conservative: absence of evidence of contradiction is not evidence of absence, but every flagged issue is grounded in real data.

stats.label: LLM-assisted pipelines
stats.value: 5 (entity refinement, closet regeneration, corpus-origin, room detection, fact-checking)

related.why: Entity refinement is one of the core LLM-integration touch points. llm_refine reclassifies regex-detected entities.
Closets (AAAK pointers) are regenerated/indexed by closet_llm. The dialect module defines the closet format.
Project mining creates initial regex closets and entity detections that LLM passes optionally refine.
CLI dispatcher routes to llm_client for provider setup, room_detector_local for init, and corpus_origin detection.
Endpoint locality detection and privacy warnings are core to the security model. No external APIs silently.
Fact-checker validates text against KG relationships. KG is the authority for entity facts.

searchDoc.title: LLM Integration
searchDoc.summary: MemPalace layers optional, pluggable LLM assistance over five domains: entity refinement, closet regeneration, corpus-origin detection, room detection, and fact-checking. Every LLM step is opt-in and local-first, with external providers available only via explicit BYOK and always behind a privacy warning. When an LLM fails the system falls back to its heuristic/regex baseline transparently.
searchDoc.body: MemPalace provides optional, pluggable LLM assistance across five domains: entity refinement reclassifies regex-detected names into person/project/topic/common-word/ambiguous; closet regeneration extracts richer topics, quotes, and summaries from drawer content; corpus-origin detection decides whether content is AI-dialogue versus prose; room detection maps folder structure to a room map; and fact-checking compares text against the entity registry and knowledge graph. All LLM steps are opt-in and local-first by default. Three providers share a common interface: Ollama on localhost:11434 for full offline operation, OpenAI-compatible endpoints covering LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM, Groq, OpenRouter, and Together, and Anthropic for explicit bring-your-own-key use. External APIs are never enabled silently and always trigger a privacy warning before first use. The llm_client module defines an LLMProvider base class with three concrete implementations and a get_provider factory that forwards unknown kwargs like num_ctx to provider constructors. Privacy is enforced by _endpoint_is_local, a single source of truth that classifies localhost, RFC1918 private ranges, Tailscale CGNAT, mDNS .local hostnames, and IPv6 unique-local addresses as local; non-HTTP schemes such as file:// are rejected to prevent exfiltration. Entity refinement batches candidates twenty-five at a time with sampled context lines, skips authoritative git-backed entries, parses responses with a six-strategy JSON extraction fallback, and is Ctrl-C safe with partial results preserved. Closet regeneration uses any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, retries up to three times with exponential backoff on decode failure or HTTP 429/503, pages large palaces in batches of 5000 to dodge a SQLite variable-number crash, and leaves regex closets as the permanent fallback. Corpus-origin detection runs a fast Tier-1 heuristic always plus an optional Tier-2 LLM, merging only platform, user, and persona names without overwriting heuristic confidence. Fact-checking is purely offline, detecting similar-name typos via edit distance up to two, relationship mismatches, and stale facts, using an O(m times n) optimization rather than all-pairs comparison. Room detection infers structure from folder names and filenames with zero API calls. When an LLM is unavailable or fails, every pipeline falls back to its heuristic, regex, or offline-validation baseline and records what happened transparently, so no operation blocks and no data is silently discarded.
